name: Shenzhen Good Morning 2020

venue.name: Electronic Innovation Service Base
venue.address: No. 126, Wanxia Rd., Shekou, Nanshan District, Shenzhen
venue.details: Meeting Room on the 1st Floor, Section 2

information:
The structure of the competition in Shenzhen this year has been modified due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
Competitors are only allowed to compete in one of the two competitions, **[Shenzhen Good Morning 2020](https://cubingchina.com/competition/Shenzhen-Good-Morning-2020)** and **[Shenzhen Good Afternoon 2020](https://cubingchina.com/competition/Shenzhen-Good-Afternoon-2020)**, in two half-days respectively.
